channel.title: Onchain Brief
channel.description: Crypto news on Bitcoin, Ethereum, DeFi, stablecoins, exchanges, wallets, security incidents, regulation and new blockchain networks.

item.title: EU proposal targets Russian crypto networks in new sanctions round
item.description: The EU has proposed targeting Russian crypto and payment networks in a new sanctions package, but all 27 member states must approve it before it takes effect.

item.title: Bridge aggregators: how they widen your route choice
item.description: A bridge aggregator compares bridges and swaps for one transfer, so you can weigh route options when a single bridge lacks the token or liquidity you need.

item.title: Mayan vs deBridge routes for EVM-to-Solana transfers
item.description: Mayan vs deBridge: choose the Solana route that delivers more after fees for your token pair, then use token support and fill time to break a close quote.

item.title: Ethereum Mainnet vs Layer 2: Should You Move a Small Balance?
item.description: Ethereum mainnet vs layer 2: move a small stablecoin balance if you expect several sends or DeFi uses; keep it on mainnet if it will just sit for now.

item.title: Move Crypto from Ethereum to Solana Wallet: Pick a Route
item.description: How to move crypto from Ethereum to a Solana wallet: bridge supported tokens or withdraw on Solana, then confirm the token mint before spending.

item.title: What is smart contract risk in DeFi? Who controls the code
item.description: Smart contract risk in DeFi means a code flaw or upgrade can lose your funds; check audits, upgrade control, approvals and how much you expose to one contract.

item.title: Stablecoin Loans Against Crypto Collateral
item.description: Why do people borrow stablecoins in DeFi? They get spendable dollars or more crypto exposure while keeping collateral, and their interest pays lenders.

item.title: How to Deploy and Verify a Contract on Base Mainnet
item.description: Learn how to deploy a smart contract on Base mainnet: test on Base Sepolia, fund your wallet with ETH on Base, deploy with Foundry and verify on Basescan.

item.title: Price Impact vs Slippage on a DEX Swap
item.description: Price impact vs slippage: price impact comes from your trade size; slippage is the quote-to-fill gap when other trades land first. Estimate impact from reserves.

item.title: Revoke.cash wallet connection failures and fixes
item.description: revokecash wallet not connecting? Unlock your wallet, resolve extension conflicts, allow the request or refresh an expired WalletConnect session to reconnect fast.

item.title: EU proposal targets crypto networks aiding Russia
item.description: EU’s proposed 22nd Russia sanctions package would target crypto and payment networks, including in third countries helping Moscow evade existing restrictions.

item.title: Is cBridge decentralized enough for your next transfer?
item.description: Is cBridge decentralized? Partly: SGN validators approve transfers, but a smaller set of contract role holders can pause or delay them. Here is what that means for your funds.

item.title: Keep bridged ETH or swap it for SUI after bridging
item.description: Keep bridged ETH on Sui or swap it for SUI? Hold ETH for Ethereum exposure, or swap some for SUI to cover gas and match your plans.

item.title: Fast Mode Shares More Data Before Ethereum Inclusion
item.description: Does fast mode on a private RPC reduce transaction privacy? Yes: it reaches more builders and TEE searchers before inclusion, while staying out of Ethereum’s public mempool.

item.title: One large buy vs several small buys for a new token: what to weigh
item.description: One large buy vs several small buys for a new token: one buy usually saves fees, while a small first buy and test sell can help check the exit.

item.title: How Long Do Cross-Chain Bridge Transfers Usually Take? By Route
item.description: Cross-chain bridge transfers usually take minutes to an hour; Bitcoin confirmations add time, while native optimistic rollup withdrawals to Ethereum take about seven days.

item.title: Repaying a DeFi loan starts with the borrowed token
item.description: How to repay a DeFi loan step by step: hold the borrowed token, approve a small buffer, then repay a set amount or max and confirm your balance falls.

item.title: CFTC staff say bitcoin and ether can count toward firm reserves
item.description: CFTC staff say derivatives firms may count bitcoin, ether and some stablecoins toward a year of operating resources, with discounts and cash limits.

item.title: Price impact vs slippage: how a swap’s cost changes
item.description: Price impact vs slippage: price impact sets the quoted cost; slippage is later pool movement your tolerance allows. See how each changes swap output.

item.title: How to withdraw Bitcoin to your own wallet and confirm it
item.description: To withdraw bitcoin from an exchange to your own wallet, create a wallet, back up its seed phrase, send BTC on Bitcoin, then track the txid to confirmation.
